## Problem and change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link a related issue if there is one.

## Verification

Describe tests, builds, or device checks. For a documentation change, describe link/rendering checks.

## Scope

- [ ] I identified whether this affects static artwork, animated artwork, or both variants.
- [ ] I considered compatibility with existing music files, library data, and settings.
- [ ] I kept credentials, personal media, and generated build files out of this change.
- [ ] I preserved applicable licence and third-party notices.
